Subject: Mid-month invoice hold: request for reconciliation and wire authorization

Hi Laura —

Hope you’re well. Quick note on invoice INV-202611-77 for PayGrid (PO 48732): our AP flagged the payment as on hold because the VAT/tax entity on the invoice doesn’t match the remit entity we have on file. That’s blocking automated ACH capture.

To get this cleared quickly can you confirm two things:

- Which legal entity on your side should we remit to for this invoice (full registered name and VAT/Tax ID).
- If the card/ACH attempt fails again, can PayGrid approve a one-time wire pre-authorization so we can release payment before month-end? If yes, we’ll need a short email from AP confirming wire is acceptable and the wire reference to use.

I attached the invoice we have on file and the W-9 stub PayGrid previously sent — can you check whether you need a revised invoice or an entity merge on our side?

Ideal outcome: we get an AP confirmation to wire (if needed) and the correct remit entity so we can post by COB 2026-11-16.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: INV-202611-77.pdf (invoice), PayGrid_W9_stub.pdf (tax stub)
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@paygrid.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: PayGrid AP <payments@paygrid.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-month invoice hold: request for reconciliation and wire authorization

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the heads up and for attaching the docs. Confirming: the correct remit entity for INV-202611-77 is "PayGrid, Inc. (US)" — Tax ID 12-3456789 — and VAT fields should be left blank for US domestic invoices.

Two quick notes:
1) Our AP team attempted the virtual card authorization this morning but it showed a soft decline; they’re re-running the ACH capture at EOD.
2) We can authorize a one-time wire if the ACH fails again. AP asked you to send the wire pre-auth email to payments@paygrid.com with the invoice number and the bank reference you’ll use so they can match when funds arrive.

I’m copying AP on this so you have a direct confirmation.

Laura
Finance Ops Lead
PayGrid, Inc.
